dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Well, it's all thanks to that Arataki Itto.

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: While the Vision Hunt Decree was in effect, he was defeated by Madam Kujou Sara. He has been conjuring up a plan to take his revenge since then.

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Madam Kujou Sara saw he was very serious about the revenge, and that his fighting spirit was commendable. So they picked a day for another duel.

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: ...Somehow, Arataki Itto insisted that, due to some weird Oni rules, the rematch must be a sumo showdown at the crossroads...

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: That's just too weird! I mean, it's basically harassment against Madam Sara, right?

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: Anyway, the duel didn't happen in the end. Arataki was dragged away by some masked lady... I just hope that Madam Sara won't be affected by this...
